import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
data['label'] = data['brand'] + ' ' + data['model_year'].astype(str)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
barplot = sns.barplot(y='label', x='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', data=data, dodge=False)
plt.title('Camera Price by Model and Sensor Type')

for index, row in data.iterrows():
    barplot.text(row['price_usd'] + 100, index, f"${row['price_usd']:.0f}\n{row['sensor_type']}\n{row['body_type']}", 
                 va='center', ha='left', fontsize=9, color='black')

plt.xlabel('Price (USD)')
plt.ylabel('')
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight')
